WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(DATE '2020-01-01' + INTERVAL (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1) DAY AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) as txn_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 120)
),
customer_dates AS (
    SELECT cr.customer_id, ds.txn_date
    FROM customer_ranges cr
    JOIN date_series ds ON ds.txn_date BETWEEN cr.min_date AND cr.max_date
),
customer_daily AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.txn_date, COALESCE(dn.net_amount, 0) as net_amount
    FROM customer_dates cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON dn.customer_id = cd.customer_id AND dn.txn_date = cd.txn_date
),
customer_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as daily_balance
    FROM customer_daily
),
customer_balances_fixed AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           GREATEST(daily_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM customer_balances
),
customer_monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) as month,
           MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM customer_balances_fixed
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM customer_monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
